description: Fresh cases selected before any v3 scoring. Public convenience sample; dates and time quotations were not independently certified. User data are not included.
selectionNotes: Pre-score exclusions: all earlier Nadi fixtures and Manley book examples; Bill Clinton because published times and time-standard reports conflict; Emily Deschanel's second child's date because a June 8 announcement does not establish the delivery date.
Childbirths within one family, multiple marriages and successive political appointments are correlated; public celebrity biographies are not a representative sample.
When an event time is missing, the evaluator uses noon in the event's stated local zone. Some event locations are approximations flagged below.
